verdict.rationale: Galileo states that datasets can be built from live production data alongside synthetic and development data. Its documented Experiments feature evaluates prompts, models, and application code against dataset inputs using chosen metrics, and dataset creation and experiment runs are also exposed through the MCP server. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual trace-to-dataset workflow (the production-data claim comes only from the marketing homepage), filtering or selection of production traces into datasets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
